name: Workshop Feedback Form

scoring.report_note: Report the median of the recommendation score plus the two asset counts (permissioned quotes, clustered demands). Item means are a health check, not the product. Under 30 responses, read the raw distribution instead of an NPS percentage.

timing.distribute: at the door, in the exit path

description: The 90-second exit ticket for public workshops: 4 rating items (1-5), one 0-10 recommendation score, and two open questions that produce permissioned testimonials and a voted demand list for the next event.

instructions.when: At the door, as people leave. The box sits in the exit path; the card is poker-size, the pen is on the table. Never promise a form by email tomorrow - for public events the next-day response rate rounds to zero.
instructions.how: Anonymous by default; quotable by choice (the permission checkbox on the testimonial card). Ninety seconds is the polite maximum.

items.text: The workshop delivered what its description promised.
The length and pace were right for the material.
The facilitator kept the group working, not just listening.
I can use something from today without buying anything else.

nps_item.prompt: 0-10: how likely are you to recommend this workshop to a colleague?

open_items.prompt: In one sentence: what did this workshop give you?
What workshop should we run next?

report.title: Workshop Feedback Form — event summary
sections: Permissioned quote count and the strongest quote
Top three demanded topics by cluster count
